svg.text: class-conditioned generation of Raman spectra — encoder → latent bottleneck → conditional decoder
L_total = L_recon + β · D_KL( qφ(z|x) ‖ p(z) ) + α · L_class
L_recon = γ·MSE(x, x̂) + δ·CosineLoss(x, x̂) D_KL = ½ Σ ( μᵢ² + σᵢ² − log σᵢ² − 1 )
latent dim d = 32 α = 0.2 (auxiliary classification) β > 1 regularises the latent prior toward N(0, I)
